content:
deploy-bot: INCIDENT: Canary failure: inference-service v2 crashlooping after rollout. Pager triggered.

alex_m: seeing 500s on /v1/generate from canary only — cutting traffic.

ravi_k: rolling back canary now. suspect HPA rendered wrong in release template.

sre-oncall: what is the customer impact? which regions?

support-lead: metrics: ~12% 500s in us-west over last 6m. 3 enterprise customers reported higher error rates.

ops-bot: Alert: 500-rate spike detected (threshold 5%) — 12.3% over 6m. Dashboard: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/1739998000

alex_m: starting rollback to v1, pausing rollout and setting canary traffic to 0%.

ravi_k: kubectl snapshot:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference-service -o wide
NAME                                       READY   STATUS      RESTARTS   AGE
inference-service-canary-7b6d9f8f8-abcde   0/1     CrashLoop   7          3m
```

ravi_k: HPA snippet in rendered manifest looked wrong:
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  minReplicas: 0  # should be 2
  maxReplicas: 20
  metrics: [...]
```

sre-oncall: if minReplicas=0 and target CPU low, HPA can scale to 0 and a new pod cold-start ordering with liveness probes can cause crashloops. plausible chain.

alex_m: applied hotfix to set minReplicas=2 on canary:
```
kubectl -n prod patch hpa inference-service --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":2}]'
```

ops-bot: Kill-switch: feature flag `canary_v2_route` toggled OFF by @alex_m :thumbsup:

support-lead: Notifying affected customers via status page now. ETA for stable revert: ~8m.

sre-oncall: check nodes — we saw a cordon earlier during maintenance.

ops-bot: node snapshot:
```
$ kubectl get nodes
node-14   Ready
node-15   Ready,SchedulingDisabled  (cordoned 12m ago)
```

ravi_k: node-15 was cordoned and not fully drained; some pods rescheduled last-minute onto node-14 increasing pressure and contributing to cold-start resource races.

alex_m: rollback to v1 completed, canary pods terminating, traffic back to stable.

ops-bot: Incident update: error-rate down to 1.1% in us-west 4m after rollback.

support-lead: Customer impact summary: ~10-12m degradation window for subset of traffic, 3 customers saw elevated errors. Retries mitigated most requests. No data loss.

sre-oncall: handing off to night oncall in 20m. Follow-ups: enforce minReplicas in CI templates, gate feature-flag rollouts on HPA diffs, improve drain runbook for partial drains.

alex_m: filing follow-ups: ENG-4321 "enforce hpa.minReplicas in release pipeline" and ENG-4322 "drain-check: ensure pods fully reschedule before cutover".

support-lead: prepping status-page update and customer outreach drafts.

deploy-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Recovery confirmed. Suspected root cause: bad HPA minReplicas rendered from release template + partial node drain -> canary crashloop. Postmortem assigned.

sre-oncall: handing off to @ravi_k (night). I'll be available if anything spikes.

ravi_k: taking it. I'll validate CI templates and sync with release team tomorrow.
